summary: The latest 50 of 106 commits hold 16 behaviour changes: 3 are proven live by the stack-health and smoke checks rebuild 2 added (Container-CC runtime, wiring and proxy allow list; the served chat bundle; /seek/search/), 7 need a paid turn (every cost and models_used key, the router record, the CC reply rules, the graph reviewer firing and the chip rerun) and 6 are failure paths proven by unit tests only, none of which can fail GitHub CI except the /seek/search/ tests. The gaps that matter most: nothing checks that the model ids the box calls are accessible, so a refused id falls back silently (F1) and run 2 could measure the fallback model; the graph reviewer, rebuild 1's headline miss, still has no free live proof; and the turn record is asserted by no CI at all.

behaviour_changes.summary: Container-CC runs Claude Code 2.1.282 on node 22 with matplotlib, the CLI is checked at build; the app starts it with --fallback-model Opus 4.7, 3 retries and a 60 s request timeout; the bedrock-proxy allows exactly opus-4-8, opus-4-7 and sonnet-4-6. Most of it came in by merge 3b53fc2e (9dc614a7, 4f367bd5, d5b8b245, a1ffc65c, a0d62dd9, 06f7809a, dde4c1cf, all outside the listed 50); F12 is 86166006.

live_check.ref: cc-agent runtime; bedrock-proxy allow list; CC fallback wiring (startup/steps/deploy_checks.py)
live_check.proves: the built dmac-assistant:poc has node 22, Claude Code 2.1.282 and imports matplotlib; the running proxy allows the checkout's three ids; the running app's CC command carries --fallback-model opus-4-7 and the three env keys and names nothing the proxy refuses. Advisory lines: judge them on the CI step, the intermediate rebuilds are expected red, and the claude --version probe (--network none) was never run on a 2.1.282 image

behaviour_changes.summary: A Container-CC reply names this turn's real paths, never the container's, computes every number it states, is told a turn can switch model, records which model answered and what fell back, and says in plain words when it hit the time limit or the model was unavailable, keeping the time-limit text after a retry that worked (d83ded8f; the rest via merge 3b53fc2e: 5ca22e3f, 06f7809a, a6ac28b2, 72c71a31, 5584b9c3, c4affc18).

proposed_checks.proves: every model id the checkout's agent_model_catalog.json, router map and CC map name is available to this box's credentials (Bedrock GetFoundationModel / GetInferenceProfile, Gemini models.get: control-plane calls, no tokens)
